decision.decision: Do not implement for the current benchmark/release toolchain: exact libc++ function only reads/writes its previous-state byte and returns, without selecting a different stream buffer or executing any I/O.
decision.next_action: Publish both-host audit evidence and mark this hypothesis evaluated, with no runtime flag or stream-buffer change.
decision.scope: Clang23.1.4 hermetic libc++ on arm64 macOS and x86_64 Linux. This is not a claim about libstdc++ or future standard libraries.
decision.validation: Disassembled actual ios.cpp.o extracted from each exact toolchain libc++.a; source/library/object/symbol/command hashes retained.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess,sys
r=Path(sys.argv[1]);h='linux' if sys.platform=='linux' else 'macos';root=r.parent
assert not (root/'xff-context-render-experiment'/('TIMING-'+h.upper()+'.ACTIVE')).exists()
assert not (root/'xff-bulk-metadata-experiment'/('PAUSE-'+h.upper())).exists()
proof=json.loads((root/'xff-cctz-empty-format-experiment'/('actual-release-provenance-'+h+'.json')).read_text());compiler=Path(proof['compiler']);package=compiler.parent.parent
libraries=list(package.glob('lib/**/libc++.a'));assert len(libraries)==1, libraries;library=libraries[0]
listing=subprocess.check_output([str(compiler.parent/'llvm-ar'),'t',str(library)],text=True);members=[v for v in listing.splitlines() if v.endswith('ios.cpp.o')];assert len(members)==1,members
obj=r/('libcxx-ios-'+h+'.o');obj.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output([str(compiler.parent/'llvm-ar'),'p',str(library),members[0]]))
nm=subprocess.check_output([str(compiler.parent/'llvm-nm'),'--defined-only',str(obj)],text=True);symbols=[v.split()[-1] for v in nm.splitlines() if v.split()[-1].endswith('15sync_with_stdioEb')];assert len(symbols)==1,symbols
command=[str(compiler.parent/'llvm-objdump'),'-d','--disassemble-symbols='+symbols[0],str(obj)];p=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
(r/('libcxx-sync-with-stdio-'+h+'.txt')).write_text(p.stdout+'\n'+p.stderr)
v=dict(host=h,library=str(library),library_sha256=hashlib.sha256(library.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),object_member=members[0],object_sha256=hashlib.sha256(obj.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),symbol=symbols[0],command=command,disassembly=p.stdout,interpretation_pending_review=True,no_runtime_changes=True,no_timing_invocation=True)
(r/('libcxx-sync-with-stdio-'+h+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n');print(p.stdout,flush=True)
